purpose: derive the bank service operations from the integration material

notes: Source: the integration document (service contract, Mert Koç, 1 Oct 2026). Paths are base path /voice/v1/ plus the service name with its dots kept (e.g. POST /voice/v1/cards.list), all POST, JSON, UTF-8. The integration document wins over the flow drawing.
Envelope: service fields go under "data". "call" holds {"ani": "<caller's number>", "lang": "tr"}. No call variable provides the caller's number, so only lang "tr" is fixed. Test ignores "call".

Auth: a bearer token from POST /oauth2/token (client_credentials, scope voice.statement) plus the Content-Type and Accept headers. The test environment does not check them; the contract says to send them anyway. 401 is a gateway answer with no documented body (get a new token and retry once), so it is not listed as a response. statement.week.change lists it explicitly.
Success = HTTP 200 and result.returnCode "1". Error bodies have only "result", no "data".

Example success bodies come from test customer 90000001 in test-customers.json. The MULTI_CARD and phone-only bodies come from the contract. Where the material gives no guid, rootCause or errorOrigin for an error, the contract's placeholder style is used. These fields are diagnostic only. Real bodies must be served from test-customers.json.

Errors for unknown data in the mock (contract section 6 and test-customers.md): a 404 where the service has one (cards.list FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102, cards.balance FB_IVR_CHANNEL_120, statement.week.get FB_IVR_CHANNEL_121, statement.pdf.send FB_IVR_CHANNEL_107). Otherwise a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR (statement.week.decide, statement.week.change, contact.email.get). The card's current week has no decide/change entry, so it gets a 400.
cards.list 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 is a WARNING meaning no eligible card (go to the main menu), not a service failure. A 500 means the service failed (go to an agent).

Card numbers are masked first 6 + last 4 in cards.list and statement.week.get, and first 4 + last 4 in cards.balance. Always send the cards.list value. cardNumberLast4 is not unique. Per Selin's 9 Oct mail, production returns full numbers, but the mock follows the test data. Never read more than the last four digits.
cards.balance currency blocks can be missing (no debtGBP on some cards). A missing block is not NO_DEBT and is left out of the no-debt sentence.

statement.week.decide returns the due date as statementDueDate, not lastPayDate. statement.week.change returns statementWeek and statementDay as strings. The dates read to the caller come from decide.
One test entry has delaySeconds above 10. The mock waits that long and then answers; delaySeconds is not part of the body.
customerNo and newStatementWeek accept a string or a number. They are typed here as string and integer.

No service tells in advance whether the yearly statement-week change right (once per calendar year, Kerem 7 Oct, replacing the IVR's 'ayda bir / yılda üç' limits) is still available. That flag is an open point.
